orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Paid orders from your online storefront.
orders.emptyDescription: When someone checks out on your storefront, their order lands here — with what they bought and where it's going.
orders.emptyNote: the first one is a good day

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Every paid transaction, in person and online, with what was in it.
sales.truncated: Showing the {{shown}} most recent transactions — narrow the dates for a complete total.
sales.emptyDescription: Sales taken on the till and orders from your storefront both land here, itemised, as soon as they are paid.
sales.recoverDescription: Older sales were recorded without their contents. Card and TWINT payments still carry a description of what was in the basket, so those can be rebuilt from Stripe. Cash sales left no such trace and cannot be recovered.
sales.recoverNothing: Nothing to recover — every sale already has its contents.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: How your shop is doing, and what to do next.
insights.slowMoversDescription: Live a while without selling — consider restyling the photo or adjusting the price.
insights.aiDescription: A written read on what's selling and what to change next.

credits.title: AI usage
credits.description: AI photo generation is included with your plan — a monthly allowance on Free, unmetered on Pro. Queries are never the meter.
credits.upsellDescription: Pro removes the monthly allowance entirely — and the 1% online fee with it.
credits.upgradeSuffix: . Your allowance also resets automatically each month.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Catch sales that slipped through without a clean match, and tie each one back to the right piece.
reconciliation.stripeDescription: Scan recent payments on your own Stripe account for any missing from your records, and email a match request for each.
reconciliation.stripeIdle: Reads your connected Stripe account — the one your customers pay into. Best run at the end of a selling day. We'll never double-count a payment already in your orders.
reconciliation.stripeFoundSent_one: {{count}} payment is waiting for a match — a review email was sent.
reconciliation.stripeFoundSent_other: {{count}} payments are waiting for a match — a review email was sent.
reconciliation.stripeFoundNotSent_one: {{count}} payment is waiting for a match — the review email could not be sent, so it is shown below.
reconciliation.stripeFoundNotSent_other: {{count}} payments are waiting for a match — the review email could not be sent, so they are shown below.
reconciliation.stripeNoCandidates_one: {{count}} unmatched payment found, but no in-stock piece was close enough in price to guess.
reconciliation.stripeNoCandidates_other: {{count}} unmatched payments found, but no in-stock piece was close enough in price to guess.
reconciliation.stripeClean: No unmatched Stripe payments found ({{count}} checked).
reconciliation.stripeReviewDescription: The review email could not be delivered, so here it is. Assign each payment to a piece, or mark it for manual review — the links do exactly what the email's would.
reconciliation.posDescription: Find amount-only POS sales (cash, card, or TWINT) with no piece attached and email a one-click confirm for the likely match.
reconciliation.posIdle: Sold a piece at a market for a round number without scanning it? This finds it and asks you to confirm which piece it was.
reconciliation.posFoundSent_one: {{count}} sale is waiting to be confirmed — a review email was sent.
reconciliation.posFoundSent_other: {{count}} sales are waiting to be confirmed — a review email was sent.
reconciliation.posFoundNotSent_one: {{count}} sale is waiting to be confirmed — the review email could not be sent, so it is shown below.
reconciliation.posFoundNotSent_other: {{count}} sales are waiting to be confirmed — the review email could not be sent, so they are shown below.
reconciliation.posNoCandidates_one: {{count}} sale found, but no in-stock piece was close enough in price to guess.
reconciliation.posNoCandidates_other: {{count}} sales found, but no in-stock piece was close enough in price to guess.
reconciliation.posClean: No unattributed in-person sales found ({{count}} checked).
reconciliation.posReviewDescription: The review email could not be delivered, so here it is. Tap the piece each sale was, or mark it for manual review — the links do exactly what the email's would.
reconciliation.pendingStripeDescription: Every unmatched Stripe payment you haven't decided on yet. Pick the piece each one paid for — no email involved.
reconciliation.pendingStripeRef: Stripe payment {{id}}, with no matching order or in-person sale.
reconciliation.pendingPosDescription: Every in-person sale rung up as an amount only that you haven't tied to a piece yet.
reconciliation.pendingPosLabel: Rung up as “{{label}}” with no piece attached.
reconciliation.pendingPosNoLabel: Rung up as an amount only, with no piece attached.
reconciliation.pendingAssigned: CHF {{amount}} recorded as a sale of {{name}}. Inventory updated.
reconciliation.pendingSetAside: Left for you to sort out. Inventory unchanged.
reconciliation.pendingFailed: That decision could not be applied.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.description: Take card and TWINT payments in person — at markets, fairs, or your studio — right from your phone.
pos.tapToPayBody: Accept contactless cards and phones by tapping them to your device — no extra hardware.
pos.twintBody: Swiss customers pay with the TWINT app. Enabled automatically once payments are connected.
pos.qrCardBody: Your own TWINT sticker, shown on screen to scan. Pays you directly at TWINT's rate — no Stripe in between.
pos.step1Description: Link your own Stripe account so in-person sales pay out directly to you.
pos.connectedNote: Your Stripe account is connected — payouts go straight to you.
pos.connectIntro: You'll be taken to Stripe to connect or create an account. This is the same connection used for online checkout.
pos.connectMissing: Stripe Connect isn't set up on the platform yet.
pos.step2Description: The register runs as an app on your phone — that's what takes the payment.
pos.step3Description: Your POS app authenticates with your store's POS API key.
pos.terminalProvisionedNote: Provisioned — your device is registered for Tap to Pay.
pos.terminalPendingNote: Created automatically the first time you take a payment.
pos.step4Description: Upload the QR code TWINT gave you and the POS can show it on screen — the customer scans it and pays you directly, at TWINT's own rate.
pos.qrExplain1: This is the sticker TWINT issues with your acceptance contract. Because TWINT doesn't tell us when a scan is paid, the POS asks you to confirm the payment landed in your TWINT app — the same way it handles cash.
pos.qrExplain2: The customer types the amount themselves, so the POS shows it in large type next to your code.
pos.errQrType: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of your TWINT QR code.
pos.errQrSize: That image is over 5 MB — try a smaller export.
pos.howStep1: Open the Zolto POS app on your phone and sign in with your POS API key.
pos.howStep2: Add the item — or enter an amount — and choose Tap to Pay or TWINT.
pos.howStep3: Have the customer tap their card or phone, or scan the TWINT code.
pos.howStep4: Inventory syncs back here automatically, so a sold piece leaves your online shop too.

myAccount.title: My account
myAccount.description: You, personally — separate from your shop's details.
myAccount.nameDescription: Shown to your team; never shown to customers.
myAccount.signInDescription: Your login identity. Changing it needs support, because a new address has to be proved before it can open your shop.
myAccount.supportNote: Need a different email on this account? Contact support — orders, receipts, and your team's invitations are tied to it.
myAccount.sessionDescription: Signing out ends this session on this device only.

platform.operatorOnly: Platform metrics are for the Zolto operator only.
platform.title: Platform metrics
platform.description: Zolto-wide, for {{month}} (UTC). Free vendors pay {{fee}} on online and agent orders; Pro is CHF {{price}}/mo and pays none.
platform.northStarLabel: North star — free in-person vendors selling online
platform.northStarLine: {{selling}} of {{total}} free vendors who sold in person this month also made an online or agent sale.
platform.northStarNone: No free vendor has sold in person yet this month, so there is nothing to convert.
platform.northStarFootnote: A free, in-person-only vendor pays Zolto nothing — by design. This ratio is whether the model works.
platform.statFeesHint: The Free plan's share of online sales
platform.sweepDescription: Scan every store that has connected Stripe, each against their own account, for succeeded payments missing from our records. Each merchant is emailed their own shortlist to confirm.
platform.failedLine_one: {{count}} store could not be scanned — listed below. The rest still completed.
platform.failedLine_other: {{count}} stores could not be scanned — listed below. The rest still completed.
platform.sweepIdle: Stores with no connected Stripe account are skipped — an in-person-only merchant has no online payments to reconcile. Safe to re-run: a payment already recorded is never queued twice.
platform.keyDescription: The platform's own POS API key, backing the ordinary 'platform-tests' store. The POS apps' CI authenticates with it, so no pipeline ever skips a test for lack of a key — and because it is a normal per-tenant key with no special rules, CI reproduces issues faithfully.
platform.rotated: POS test key rotated — copy it now, it can't be shown again.
platform.rotateFailed: Could not rotate the POS test key.
platform.shownOnce: Shown once — copy it into the POS apps' CI secret (POS_API_KEY) now. It cannot be shown again.
platform.copyFailed: Copy failed — select it by hand.
platform.rotateIdle: Rotating provisions the store on first use and invalidates the previous key immediately — update the CI secret in the same sitting.
platform.subsDescription: Watch canceled and past-due through the off-season — seasonality is the model's known weak point.

import.title: Import
import.description: Add products in bulk — from a spreadsheet, a folder of photos, or by tidying duplicates.
import.csvBody: Bring in a whole catalogue from a spreadsheet. Map your columns and preview before importing.
import.photosBody: Drop a batch of photos and let AI draft a name, description, and price for each piece.
import.duplicatesBody: Find and merge near-identical products created by repeated imports.

duplicates.title: Duplicate Cleanup
duplicates.subtitle: Products that share the exact same name — usually left behind by re-importing a spreadsheet
duplicates.warning: Deleting a duplicate permanently removes it from the catalogue — this cannot be undone. Pick which copy of each product to keep.
duplicates.confirmDescription: These products will be permanently removed from the catalogue, including their photos. This cannot be undone.

siteImport.title: Bring your old shop with you
siteImport.summary: Point us at the site you sell on today and we will read it — products, prices, stock, photos, categories and your look.
siteImport.previewCta: See what we can bring over
siteImport.freeNote: Reading your site is free. You see everything we found — and how much of it — before anything is charged.
siteImport.extraCategoriesHint: Recreate the {{count}} sections your site uses
siteImport.extraBrandingFound: Carry your logo and brand colour over
siteImport.extraNothingFound: Nothing we could read on that site
siteImport.whyPaid: This runs a real crawl over your site every time. You pay for the work of moving, once — never a monthly fee for keeping what is already yours.
siteImport.nothingToCharge: There is nothing here worth charging you for. Try the address of a category page, or use the tools below.
siteImport.checkoutUnavailable: Card payments are not set up on this deployment, so this import cannot be purchased here.
siteImport.paidReady: Payment received — ready to add to your shop.
siteImport.doneHidden: {{count}} arrived hidden because we could not read a price. Set one and they go live.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.description: What AI assistants and crawlers read from your shop. They fetch your product brief and can buy through it — a sale from one lands as an online order.
agents.empty: No AI agent has read your shop yet. Your product brief and the agent shopping endpoint are live and waiting — nothing to set up.

till.title: Till
till.description: Ring up a sale and take payment on the spot — card by QR, your own TWINT code, or cash.
till.noMatches: Nothing matches. Try a different search.
till.emptyCart: Tap a product to add it.
till.cardMethodsNote: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or TWINT — the payment page decides.
till.twintQrBody: The customer enters {{amount}} in their TWINT app.
till.twintQrAttestNote: This one doesn't go through Stripe, so nothing here can confirm it. Check your own TWINT notification first.
till.twintQrConfirm: I've seen the payment — record it

sheets.title: Spreadsheet
sheets.description: Your sales and inventory in a Google Sheet you can filter, pivot and hand to your accountant.
sheets.unavailableBody: This Zolto install has no Google service account configured, so spreadsheet mirrors are switched off. Ask whoever runs it to set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL and GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.
sheets.connectBody: We make the sheet, keep it up to date, and share it with you.
sheets.shareWithHint: Google Drive can only share with a Google account, and your Zolto sign-in isn't one — so tell us which Google address to use.
sheets.directionNote: The sheet shows what Zolto has recorded. It is refreshed every hour, and any edit you make to the Sales or Inventory tabs is replaced on the next refresh — so those tabs are locked. Once the sheet exists you can switch on a Stock In tab to propose stock changes from it.
sheets.yourSheetBody: Refreshed every hour. Sales and Inventory are published by Zolto and can't be edited in Google — but the sheet is yours to download or copy whenever you like.
sheets.syncedStockInPending: Sales and Inventory refreshed. Stock In was left alone because it has entries waiting for approval.
sheets.syncFailedHint: If the file was deleted or you removed your own access, disconnect and create it again.
sheets.disconnectHint: Disconnecting stops the hourly refresh and removes your access to the sheet. The file itself is kept, so support can hand it back — but download a copy first if you want to keep one.
sheets.disconnectedToast: Disconnected — refreshing stopped and your access was removed
sheets.stockInTitle: Stock In — changes from the sheet
sheets.stockInBody: Let the sheet propose stock and price changes, which you then approve here.
sheets.stockInToggle: Allow me to type changes into the Stock In tab
sheets.stockInToggleHint: This gives your Google account edit access to the file. Sales and Inventory stay locked; only the Stock In tab becomes writable.
sheets.stockInDeltaNote: In the Stock In tab, qty_delta is a change, not a total: write +2 for two more, -1 for one fewer. That way anything you sell while the sheet is open still counts.
sheets.stockInError: Could not change the Stock In setting

stockIn.title: Waiting for your approval
stockIn.description: What the Stock In tab currently proposes. Nothing is written until you approve it.
stockIn.idleHint: Press Review to read the Stock In tab and see what it would change.
stockIn.previewError: Could not read the Stock In tab
stockIn.emptyBody: The Stock In tab has no entries. Type into it in Google Sheets, then come back and press Review.
stockIn.rejectedHint: These rows stay in the sheet so they can be corrected. They are not part of the approval above.
stockIn.unchangedNote_one: {{count}} row already matches the catalogue and will be cleared.
stockIn.unchangedNote_other: {{count}} rows already match the catalogue and will be cleared.
